name: sgm
description: SGM (Small Generative Model) - a CPU-trained image/text/code model with a pure JS/HTML/CSS inference app

scripts.generate: node web/cli.mjs --model web_model --task image --prompt "generate the image of a white car"
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:http && npm run test:tasks && npm run test:web && npm run test:store && npm run test:gallery && npm run test:zip && npm run test:models && npm run test:desktop
